metadata.source: OWASP Testing Guide, Public SSTI knowledge

description: SSTI occurs when user input is embedded in template without proper sanitization, allowing code execution.

testing: Test with {{7*7}} — if 49 in response, possible SSTI
Try different syntax for different engines (Jinja2, Twig, etc.)
Never use RCE payloads without approval
methodology.verification: Reproduce with math payload, check engine, try to get config without RCE

remediation: Avoid user input in templates, sandbox, validate input
